top_signals.title: 83-year-old VTuber posts wartime stories of Manchuria
top_signals.summary: Kuniko Asai, who was born in Manchuria during World War II and who now lives in Ishikawa Prefecture, relates the experiences of people who returned to Japan from the region.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Can Dogs Transform Cancer Screening?
top_signals.summary:
Dogs have been used to sniff out drugs, explosives and even Covid. Could cancer be next? An Indian startup is combining canine noses with AI in an effort to make cancer screening cheaper and more accessible.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
